status_detail: All exposures and the population phenotype are prescription drugs or a staged procedure, so this study is not blocked by the inputevents ETL gap (see docs/validation_question_bank.md, F1-F7). Remaining work before a run: (1) human approval of the PPI, H2RA and mechanical-ventilation concept sets; (2) generation and clinical review of a candidate DAG against reference_dag.json; (3) confirming the new-user look-back and the single-first-agent rule against the data. Question bank id: Q1 (= candidate B1 in docs/validation_study_candidates.md).
source_question: Among adult ICU patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation, what is the effect of proton pump inhibitor versus histamine-2 receptor antagonist stress-ulcer prophylaxis, started within 48 hours of the initiation of mechanical ventilation, on in-hospital all-cause mortality?

anchor_trial.name: PEPTIC
anchor_trial.citation: PEPTIC Investigators; Australian and New Zealand Intensive Care Society Clinical Trials Group. Effect of Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis With Proton Pump Inhibitors vs Histamine-2 Receptor Blockers on In-Hospital Mortality Among ICU Patients Receiving Invasive Mechanical Ventilation: The PEPTIC Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. 2020;323(7):616-626.
anchor_trial.design: Cluster crossover randomized trial, 50 ICUs, 5 countries, 26,982 patients.

supporting_emulations.citation: Comparison of proton pump inhibitors and histamine 2 receptor antagonists for stress ulcer prophylaxis in the intensive care unit. Sci Rep. 2021;11:18424.
supporting_emulations.note: Retrospective ICU cohort with an explicit adjustment set. [verify article no.]

data_source: runtime-configured restricted OMOP dataset (MIMIC-IV v2.2 -> OMOP CDM 5.3.1, OHDSI/MIMIC ETL)

target_trial.population: Adults receiving invasive mechanical ventilation in the ICU
target_trial.treatment: A proton pump inhibitor (pantoprazole, omeprazole, esomeprazole, lansoprazole, rabeprazole) ordered within 48 hours of the initiation of invasive mechanical ventilation, as the first stress-ulcer-prophylaxis agent of the ICU stay
target_trial.comparator: A histamine-2 receptor antagonist (famotidine, ranitidine, cimetidine, nizatidine) ordered within 48 hours of the initiation of invasive mechanical ventilation, as the first stress-ulcer-prophylaxis agent of the ICU stay
target_trial.time_zero: The first qualifying stress-ulcer-prophylaxis order (PPI or H2RA) within 48 hours of the first invasive mechanical ventilation procedure of the first ICU stay
secondary_estimands: ATE on clinically important upper-gastrointestinal bleeding (exploratory; low-PPV condition code paired with a transfusion or upper-endoscopy procedure)
CATE by admission type (medical vs surgical/trauma)
eligibility_criteria: Receiving invasive mechanical ventilation initiated within 24 hours of the first ICU admission (PEPTIC's window). A wider 'invasive ventilation at any point during the first ICU stay' definition is a prespecified sensitivity analysis.
First ICU stay per patient only
No PPI and no H2RA order in the 90 days before ICU admission (new-user of acid suppression)

Exactly one prophylaxis class as the first agent within the 48-hour window; patients whose first orders include both classes, or neither class, are excluded from the primary analysis and characterised separately

No baseline indication for therapeutic (non-prophylactic) acid suppression: active gastrointestinal bleeding, or endoscopically or clinically documented peptic ulcer disease within 30 days before time zero. A sensitivity analysis without this exclusion is prespecified.
target_trial.assignment_procedure: Not randomized; the prophylaxis class is the treating clinician's or the ICU's choice. PEPTIC randomized at the ICU level (cluster crossover); the analogous unit here is care_site, which is entered as a baseline covariate and in a care_site-stratified sensitivity analysis.
target_trial.censoring_strategy: For the in-hospital primary outcome, administrative censoring at hospital discharge (patients discharged alive before an in-hospital death are outcome-negative). For the 90-day secondary outcome, administrative censoring at the earlier of the end of the observation period or 90 days after time zero.
target_trial.analysis_strategy: Intention-to-treat analog: the first prophylaxis class is fixed at time zero and later switches or discontinuations are not modelled. PEPTIC had substantial crossover; a per-protocol sensitivity analysis censoring at the first switch to the other class is prespecified.
target_trial.treatment_value: Proton pump inhibitor as the first stress-ulcer-prophylaxis agent within 48 hours of mechanical-ventilation initiation
target_trial.comparator_value: Histamine-2 receptor antagonist as the first stress-ulcer-prophylaxis agent within 48 hours of mechanical-ventilation initiation

design_constraints: Active-comparator new-user design: both arms share the same indication (stress-ulcer prophylaxis in a ventilated patient), which controls confounding by indication and generally supports positivity. A large effect in either direction is a design or mapping failure to diagnose, not a finding.
Use only covariates measured before or at time zero (first-day labs and vitals, comorbidity history, admission type, baseline drug exposure).
care_site is a clustered confounder (PEPTIC's randomization unit; ICU-level prescribing culture). Adjust for it and run a care_site-stratified sensitivity analysis.
Calendar year is a confounder: PPI uptake for stress-ulcer prophylaxis increased across MIMIC-IV's 2008-2019 window.

The upper-gastrointestinal-bleeding secondary has low positive predictive value from a condition code alone; require pairing with a transfusion or an upper-endoscopy procedure and treat it as exploratory, never as a co-primary.
Ranitidine is retained in the H2RA set: it was in routine use across MIMIC-IV's data window and was withdrawn only in 2020.
Do not promote text-matched drug or procedure names to executable concept sets without human review.

proton_pump_inhibitor.note: Approve RxNorm ingredient seeds plus concept_ancestor descendants. Exclude combination products where the PPI is not the acid-suppression agent of interest (e.g. amoxicillin/clarithromycin H. pylori kits) unless a sensitivity analysis keeps them.

resolution.UNDERCOUNT_CAVEAT: These are billing procedure codes (ICD-9-Proc + ICD-10-PCS). Union = 14,662 distinct persons. The true invasively-ventilated MIMIC-IV population is ~25,000-30,000: the procedureevents 'Invasive Ventilation' itemid and chartevents ventilator-setting rows do not map to a standard ventilation procedure concept in this ETL build. The billing-code cohort is real but skews toward longer / billed courses. This is an ETL-coverage limitation to state in the writeup, analogous to the inputevents gap. A sensitivity analysis using SNOMED 4230167 'Artificial ventilation' + descendants (9,388 persons, but includes non-invasive) is the alternative.
resolution.SNOMED_37158404: 'Invasive mechanical ventilation' has 0 rows in this build - do NOT use it as the seed.

upper_gi_bleeding.note: Exploratory secondary only. Pair the condition code with a red-cell transfusion or an upper-endoscopy procedure within the same window to raise PPV.

seed_concepts.192671: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage + descendants (11,877 condition_occurrence rows / 8,558 persons)

published_benchmarks.source: PEPTIC, JAMA 2020;323(7):616-626, doi:10.1001/jama.2019.22190. Read the exact figures from the primary text before scoring.
published_benchmarks.expected_pipeline_result: Risk difference approximately 0 with a confidence interval covering 0, possibly a small PPI-associated harm. Recovering this near-null is a specificity test.

feasibility_checklist.F1_exposure_is_drug_or_coded_procedure: PASS - PPI and H2RA are oral/IV prescriptions (~96.8% standard-mapped); ventilation is a staged procedure.
feasibility_checklist.F2_ever_exposed_in_window_is_enough: PASS - the contrast is which class is ordered first; no dose or rate needed.
feasibility_checklist.F3_clean_index_short_window: PASS - active-comparator new-user; time zero is the first qualifying order.
feasibility_checklist.F4_outcome_reliably_captured: PASS - in-hospital and 90-day mortality from the death record. UGIB secondary is low-PPV; keep exploratory.
feasibility_checklist.F6_adequate_n_and_followup: PASS - roughly 15,000-20,000 ventilated adult first ICU stays; the smaller arm is expected to be H2RA in later years.
feasibility_checklist.F7_confounders_measurable: PASS - first-day severity, coagulation, comorbidity history, admission type, baseline drug exposure, care_site, calendar year.
